panels.title: 电脑开机总时长 (已剔除睡眠)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(duration_seconds) as value
FROM app_usage_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND process_name != 'System_Idle'

SELECT
  -- 1. 🎯 统计息屏挂机总长：风扇在转、屏幕黑着、人不在
  SUM(CASE WHEN process_name = 'System_DisplayOff' THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) as "显示器熄灭时长",
  
  -- 2. 🎯 统计真硬件睡眠总长：主板合盖、风扇彻底停转的冷冻时间
  SUM(CASE WHEN process_name = 'System_Sleep' THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) as "操作系统深睡眠时长"
FROM app_usage_logs
-- 🔒 完美套用 Grafana 全局时间筛选器，支持任意历史跨度查询
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time);

SELECT
  CASE 
    -- 💻 核心核心生产力 (研发、数据与终端)
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('code.exe', 'cursor.exe') THEN '💻 开发工具: VS Code / Cursor'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'idea64.exe' THEN '☕ 开发工具: IntelliJ IDEA'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'datagrip64.exe' THEN '🗄️ 数仓工具: DataGrip'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'windowsterminal.exe' THEN '💻 终端工具: Windows Terminal'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'powershell_ise.exe' THEN '💻 终端工具: PowerShell ISE'

    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'typora.exe' THEN '📝 笔记工具: Typora'

    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'searchhost.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: Windows 本地搜索栏'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'applicationframehost.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: UWP 应用外壳框架'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: Windows 开始菜单'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('shellexperiencehost.exe', 'shellhost.exe') THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: Windows 外壳体验宿主'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'phoneexperiencehost.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: 手机连接 (Phone Link)'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'credentialuibroker.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: 凭据认证弹窗'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'openwith.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: 打开方式选择器'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'fvenotify.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: BitLocker 加密通知'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'pcaui.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: 程序兼容性助手'
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'wscript.exe' THEN '🖥️ 系统组件: Windows 脚本宿主'

    -- 🛡️ 安全防御与 360 附属升级/通知组件
    WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('360safe.exe', '360tray.exe', '360logcenter.exe', '360leakfix.exe', '360speedld.exe', '360desktoplite64.exe', '360settingcenter.exe', '360dnsopt.exe', '360zipupdate.exe', 'softupnotify.exe', 'pcbu_desktop.exe', 'datamain.exe') THEN '🛡️ 安全防护: 360安全隐私服务群'
    
    -- 🏁 兜底未清洗的离散应用
    ELSE '🚀 应用: ' || process_name 
  END as "活动归属",
  SUM(duration_seconds) as "累计时长"
FROM app_usage_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND process_name NOT IN ('System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff', 'System_Idle', 'Idle')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: 前台独占工时高精分布 (今天/实时)

targets.rawSql:
WITH base_logs AS (
    SELECT 
        process_name,
        -- 🧼 1. 统一阻击：在底层直接利用正则切掉所有 IDE、浏览器和编辑器的末尾冗余后缀
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            window_title, 
            ' - (Google Chrome|Microsoft Edge|Visual Studio Code|Cursor|Typora|IntelliJ IDEA|DataGrip)$', 
            '', 
            'i'
        ) AS cleaned_title,
        duration_seconds
    FROM app_usage_logs
    WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
      -- 🚫 剔除无交互的系统挂机噪音
      AND process_name NOT IN ('System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff', 'System_Idle', 'Idle')
      AND window_title IS NOT NULL 
      AND window_title != ''
      AND window_title != 'Windows 桌面 / 壁纸层'
),
context_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            -- 💬 1. 隐私护卫网 (核心升级)：对微信强制脱敏，隐藏具体的聊天对象或群组名称，保护隐私安全
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'weixin.exe' THEN '💬 社交沟通: 微信 (窗口标题已脱敏)'

            -- 🤖 2. AI 生产力原生工程 (精准捕获你的大模型交互上下文)
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%Google AI Studio%' THEN '🤖 AI 调试: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%Gemini%' THEN '🤖 AI 对话: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%ChatGPT%' OR cleaned_title LIKE '%xAI%' THEN '🤖 AI 助理: ' || cleaned_title
            
            -- 🐙 3. 线上开源库与本地调试纵深
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%GitHub%' THEN '🐙 开源社区: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%localhost%' OR cleaned_title LIKE '%127.0.0.1%' THEN '🌐 本地联调: ' || cleaned_title

            -- ☕ 4. Java 核心研发与数据库重装数仓
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'idea64.exe' THEN '☕ IDEA项目: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'datagrip64.exe' THEN '🗄️ SQL架构: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('code.exe', 'cursor.exe') THEN '💻 代码心流: ' || cleaned_title

            -- 📝 5. 知识沉淀、终端运维与系统组件
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'typora.exe' THEN '📝 Markdown: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'windowsterminal.exe' THEN '💻 终端指令: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'taskmgr.exe' THEN '📊 系统内核: 任务管理器'
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'explorer.exe' AND cleaned_title LIKE '文件管理器:%' THEN '📁 磁盘路径: ' || cleaned_title

            -- 🛡️ 6. 后台防御及安全组件归类
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('360safe.exe', '360tray.exe', '360logcenter.exe') THEN '🛡️ 系统防护: 360安全卫士'
            
            -- 🏁 7. 兜底未清洗的长尾离散上下文
            ELSE '🚀 [' || process_name || '] ' || cleaned_title
        END AS task_context,
        duration_seconds
    FROM base_logs
)
-- 📊 3. 终审收盘：去除首尾空格并执行高精聚合，完美防重漏
SELECT 
    TRIM(task_context) AS "微观任务上下文",
    SUM(duration_seconds) AS "累计时长"
FROM context_mapped
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "累计时长" DESC;

WITH base_logs AS (
    SELECT 
        start_time,
        process_name,
        -- 🧼 1. 统一阻击：切掉所有软件的末尾冗余后缀
        REGEXP_REPLACE(
            window_title, 
            ' - (Google Chrome|Microsoft Edge|Visual Studio Code|Cursor|Typora|IntelliJ IDEA|DataGrip)$', 
            '', 
            'i'
        ) AS cleaned_title,
        duration_seconds
    FROM app_usage_logs
    WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
      -- 🚫 剔除挂机和锁屏
      AND process_name NOT IN ('System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff', 'System_Idle', 'Idle')
      AND window_title IS NOT NULL 
      AND window_title != ''
      AND window_title != 'Windows 桌面 / 壁纸层'
),
context_mapped AS (
    SELECT
        start_time,
        CASE
            -- 💬 1. 微信隐私护卫
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'weixin.exe' THEN '💬 社交沟通: 微信 (窗口标题已脱敏)'

            -- 🤖 2. AI 炼丹与调试
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%Google AI Studio%' THEN '🤖 AI 调试: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%Gemini%' THEN '🤖 AI 对话: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%ChatGPT%' OR cleaned_title LIKE '%xAI%' THEN '🤖 AI 助理: ' || cleaned_title
            
            -- 🐙 3. 开源社区与本地联调
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%GitHub%' THEN '🐙 开源社区: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN cleaned_title LIKE '%localhost%' OR cleaned_title LIKE '%127.0.0.1%' THEN '🌐 本地联调: ' || cleaned_title

            -- ☕ 4. 研发核心工具
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'idea64.exe' THEN '☕ IDEA项目: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'datagrip64.exe' THEN '🗄️ SQL架构: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('code.exe', 'cursor.exe') THEN '💻 代码心流: ' || cleaned_title

            -- 📝 5. 运维与系统组件
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'typora.exe' THEN '📝 Markdown: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'windowsterminal.exe' THEN '💻 终端指令: ' || cleaned_title
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'taskmgr.exe' THEN '📊 系统内核: 任务管理器'
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) = 'explorer.exe' AND cleaned_title LIKE '文件管理器:%' THEN '📁 磁盘路径: ' || cleaned_title

            -- 🛡️ 6. 安全服务
            WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('360safe.exe', '360tray.exe', '360logcenter.exe') THEN '🛡️ 系统防护: 360安全卫士'
            
            -- 🏁 7. 长尾离散应用
            ELSE '🚀 [' || process_name || '] ' || cleaned_title
        END AS task_context,
        duration_seconds
    FROM base_logs
)
-- 📊 3. 时区强制对齐：将时间戳先转换至东八区再进行切片，彻底干掉时区差
SELECT 
    TO_CHAR(start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai', 'HH24:MI:SS') AS "切换时刻",
    TRIM(task_context) AS "动作上下文",
    duration_seconds AS "停留时长"
FROM context_mapped
ORDER BY start_time DESC; -- 👈 底层依然按原生时间线绝对倒序

WITH time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS t_from,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz AS t_to
),
interval_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    GREATEST(interval '1 minute', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.t_to - b.t_from)) / 2000)::int)) AS dt
  FROM time_bounds b
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT g.grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b, interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_from) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from b.t_to) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(grid_time)
),
state_aligned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (g.bucket_time)
    g.bucket_time,
    a.duration_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN a.process_name = 'System_Sleep' THEN '⬛ 绝对睡眠 (风扇停转)'
      WHEN a.process_name = 'System_DisplayOff' THEN '🟥 屏幕关闭 (伪睡眠/锁屏)'
      WHEN a.process_name = 'System_Idle' THEN '🟡 键鼠静止 (人不在暂离)'
      ELSE '🟢 深度工作 (正常使用中)'
    END as state
  FROM app_usage_logs a, time_bounds b, interval_calc i
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from a.start_time) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from (a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval)) / extract(epoch from i.dt)) * extract(epoch from i.dt))::timestamptz,
    i.dt
  ) g(bucket_time)
  WHERE a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time >= b.t_from - interval '1 day' AND a.start_time <= b.t_to AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval >= b.t_from
  ORDER BY g.bucket_time, a.start_time DESC
)
SELECT
  (g.grid_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') as time,
  COALESCE(sa.duration_seconds, extract(epoch from i.dt)::int) as "持续秒数",
  COALESCE(sa.state, '📴 关机离线 (未通电/无数据)') as "全盘宏观状态"
FROM time_grid g
CROSS JOIN interval_calc i
LEFT JOIN state_aligned sa ON g.grid_time = sa.bucket_time
ORDER BY time ASC;

panels.title: 用户使用电脑状态时间轴

targets.rawSql:
WITH marked_leads AS (
  SELECT
    start_time,
    duration_seconds,
    process_name,
    window_title,
    -- ⚡ 降维进化：只判断进程名是否改变！只要还在同一个应用里切换窗口，心流就绝对不断
    CASE 
      WHEN process_name = LAG(process_name) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END as is_new_session
  FROM app_usage_logs
  WHERE process_name NOT IN ('System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff', 'System_Idle')
    AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
),
session_groups AS (
  SELECT
    start_time,
    duration_seconds,
    process_name,
    window_title,
    -- 动态累加组标签
    SUM(is_new_session) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) as grp
  FROM marked_leads
),
packed_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_time) as flow_start,
    SUM(duration_seconds) as total_seconds,
    process_name,
    -- 🎯 聚合代表性上下文：提取该专注时间块内最具代表性的窗口名称
    MAX(window_title) as sample_title
  FROM session_groups
  GROUP BY grp, process_name
)
SELECT
  -- 1. 进入时刻
  (flow_start AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') as "进入心流时刻",
  -- 2. 核心进程美化显示
  CASE 
    WHEN process_name = 'chrome.exe' THEN '🌐 浏览器 (Chrome)'
    WHEN process_name = 'Code.exe' THEN '💻 编译器 (VS Code)'
    WHEN process_name = 'idea64.exe' THEN '☕ 编译器 (IntelliJ IDEA)'
    WHEN process_name = 'explorer.exe' THEN '📁 系统组件 (文件管理器)'
    ELSE '🚀 ' || process_name
  END as "核心应用",
  -- 3. 主要任务上下文
  sample_title as "主要任务上下文",
  -- 4. 听老哥的，转换成分钟级显示
  ROUND(total_seconds / 60.0, 1) as "持续专注时间(分钟)"
FROM packed_sessions
-- 🎯 生产阈值：听老哥的，只要连续呆够 5 分钟（300秒）就定义为黄金心流块
WHERE total_seconds >= 300
ORDER BY flow_start DESC;

WITH time_grid AS (
  -- 1. 🛡️ 骨架核心：显式转化 Grafana 宏为 timestamptz，彻底干掉函数重载歧义
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz),
    date_trunc('minute', $__timeTo()::timestamptz),
    '1 minute'::interval
  ) AS grid_time
),
flagged_switches AS (
  -- 2. 🗜️ 核心过滤：计算每一次真实的前台切换
  SELECT
    date_trunc('minute', start_time) as min_time,
    CASE 
      WHEN process_name = LAG(process_name) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) 
           AND window_title = LAG(window_title) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END as is_switch
  FROM app_usage_logs
  WHERE process_name NOT IN ('System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff', 'System_Idle')
    AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
),
minute_counts AS (
  -- 3. 📊 分钟级初级聚合
  SELECT 
    min_time,
    SUM(is_switch) as switch_count
  FROM flagged_switches
  GROUP BY min_time
)
-- 4. 🔗 终审合流：用骨架强行左联。没数据的分钟一律 COALESCE 强制拍成 0 次
SELECT
  (g.grid_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') as time,
  COALESCE(mc.switch_count, 0) as "每分钟前台闪切次数"
FROM time_grid g
LEFT JOIN minute_counts mc ON g.grid_time = mc.min_time
ORDER BY time ASC;

panels.title: 前台上下文“频繁闪切”干扰指数

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  -- ⚡ 核心解法：直接强转为中文年月日字符串，彻底封印 Grafana 的自动时区转换与轴缩放逻辑！
  TO_CHAR(date_trunc('day', start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'MM/DD') as "审计日期",
  -- 📊 真实活跃时间：排除暂离、物理睡眠和黑屏
  SUM(CASE WHEN process_name NOT IN ('System_Idle', 'System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff') THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) as "真实键鼠活跃时间",
  -- 💤 挂机静止时间
  SUM(CASE WHEN process_name = 'System_Idle' THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) as "挂机静止暂离时间"
FROM app_usage_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')
ORDER BY date_trunc('day', start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') ASC;

panels.title: 历史每日审计留痕 (活跃/暂离双轴堆叠)

targets.rawSql:
WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT
    CASE 
      WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('code.exe', 'cursor.exe', 'idea64.exe', 'datagrip64.exe', 'windowsterminal.exe', 'powershell_ise.exe', 'cmd.exe', 'typora.exe', 'notepad.exe', 'git-credential-manager.exe', 'java.exe') 
           OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE 'python%' 
           OR LOWER(process_name) IN ('claude.exe', 'antigravity.exe') THEN '💻 开发与AI工具'
      WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('chrome.exe', 'msedge.exe', 'firefox.exe') THEN '🌐 浏览器'
      WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('slaythespire2.exe', 'masterduel.exe', 'forzahorizon6.exe', 'flyingbird.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe', 'uu.exe') THEN '🎮 游戏与娱乐'
      WHEN LOWER(process_name) IN ('weixin.exe', 'qq.exe', 'dingtalk.exe') THEN '💬 社交与通讯'
      ELSE '🛠️ 其他应用'
    END as cat,
    SUM(duration_seconds) as dur
  FROM app_usage_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
    AND process_name NOT IN ('System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff', 'System_Idle', 'Idle')
  GROUP BY 1
),
total_data AS (
  SELECT SUM(dur) as total_dur FROM base_data
)
SELECT
  cat || ' (' || ROUND(dur / 3600.0, 2) || '小时, ' || ROUND(dur * 100.0 / total_dur, 1) || '%)' as "分类",
  dur as "累计时长"
FROM base_data, total_data
ORDER BY dur DESC;

panels.title: 每日活跃时段分布热力图 (小时×天)

targets.rawSql:
WITH weekly_data AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') as dow,
    CASE 
      WHEN start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') THEN '本周'
      ELSE '上周'
    END as week_label,
    SUM(CASE WHEN process_name NOT IN ('System_Sleep', 'System_DisplayOff', 'System_Idle', 'Idle') THEN duration_seconds ELSE 0 END) / 3600.0 as active_hours
  FROM app_usage_logs
  WHERE start_time >= (date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') - interval '1 week') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AND start_time < (date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') + interval '1 week') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  CASE dow
    WHEN 1 THEN '1.周一'
    WHEN 2 THEN '2.周二'
    WHEN 3 THEN '3.周三'
    WHEN 4 THEN '4.周四'
    WHEN 5 THEN '5.周五'
    WHEN 6 THEN '6.周六'
    WHEN 7 THEN '7.周日'
  END as "星期",
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN week_label = '本周' THEN active_hours END), 0)::numeric, 2) as "本周(小时)",
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN week_label = '上周' THEN active_hours END), 0)::numeric, 2) as "上周(小时)"
FROM weekly_data
GROUP BY dow
ORDER BY dow;
